scripts.//: do not wrap into single quotes - windows doesn't unwrap arg in this case
scripts.compile: npm run ci:test:generate && npm run build
scripts.pretest: npm run lint-deps && npm run lint
scripts.///: Please see https://github.com/electron-userland/electron-builder/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#run-test-using-cli how to run particular test instead full (and very slow) run
scripts.test-all: npm run compile && npm run pretest && npm run ci:test
scripts.ci:validate: npm run compile && npm pretest && npm generate:all
scripts.ci:version: npm i && changeset version && node scripts/update-package-version-export.js && npm changelog && npm compile && npm generate:all && git add .
scripts.ci:publish: npm i && npm compile && npm publish -r --tag ${NPM_DIST_TAG:-next} --publish-branch ${GITHUB_REF_NAME:-master} < /dev/null && changeset tag
scripts.generate:all: npm run generate:schema && npm run prettier
